text:
alex_k: Quick sync — wanted to kick off a short trendboard thread to capture recurring routing/TLS/DNS regression fingerprints from recent postmortems. Goal: 1) capture owners for each pattern 2) set short timelines 3) surface playbook gaps.

maria_g: +1. Can we focus on the two patterns we saw this quarter: cross-region TLS handshakes failing under burst, and a DNS resolver cascade on failover?

tim_ong: For TLS handshakes the pattern looks like: longer tail when we hit cold KV cache + mid-flight SNI mismatch. I sketched a mitigation that adds aggressive SNI validation logs and a fallback to region-local certs.

jess_r: linking the postmortem notes: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2026-03-routing-tls.pdf — contains packet captures + timeline.

alex_k: infra-bot, can you attach the last 72h LB metrics for the two affected clusters?

infra-bot: Attached: https://dashboards.internal/boards/lb-72h?cluster=eu-west,us-east — 95th p99/latency, TLS failures per minute, DNS lookup errors. (auto-upload)

maria_g: TL;DR from metrics: TLS failures spike aligns with autoscaler events and backend churn; DNS errors cluster during control-plane failover windows.

alex_k: Proposed owners and timelines:
- TLS handshake spike: owner tim_ong, 2w to implement additional SNI logging + backoff tuning, then 1w canary.
- DNS cascade on failover: owner jess_r, 3w to add resolver health scoring + staggered failover, then 1w validation.

jess_r: I can start a design doc today. Plan: add resolver scoring, health probe thresholds, and a small experiment to fail over gracefully within a canary pool.

tim_ong: I'll open an RFC for the SNI logging + fallback policy. Quick note: need to avoid logging secrets; pack only SNI + cert fingerprint + session metrics.

maria_g: Also, recurring pattern 3: request retries causing downstream connection storms when the LB returns 502 intermittently. Can we add a global retry budget?

alex_k: Good catch. Add pattern: "retry amplification after transient 5xx". Owner: maria_g to prototype a client-side/route-level retry budget within 2w.

jess_r: Adding a checklist to the trendboard:
- owners assigned (tim_ong, jess_r, maria_g)
- design docs linked
- canary plan + metrics to watch (TLS_fail_rate, DNS_error_rate, retry_amplification_ratio)
- rollback conditions

infra-bot: Runbook references: 
- LB TLS fallback playbook: https://playbooks.internal/lb-tls-fallback
- DNS failover playbook: https://playbooks.internal/dns-staggered-failover

alex_k: Can we agree on cadence? Suggest weekly sync for 4 weeks, then biweekly until patterns materially drop. Who can attend a 30m sync Friday 10am PT?

maria_g: I can.

tim_ong: I can too.

jess_r: I can make the first two, then sync notes after.

alex_k: Cool. Action items summary (I'll paste into the tracker):
- tim_ong: RFC + SNI logging + fallback policy — due in 2w.
- jess_r: Resolver scoring design + failover experiment — due in 3w.
- maria_g: Retry budget prototype + rollout plan — due in 2w.
- alex_k: create trendboard card, add dashboards & alert thresholds, schedule weekly Friday syncs — today.

jess_r: One more ask — can we capture a small synthetic test that reproduces the DNS cascade in a staging mesh so we can validate quickly? I volunteer to run the experiment.

alex_k: Yes please, that will be high value. Add the test link to the design doc when ready.

maria_g: For visibility, I'll add a short blurb to the SRE channel after we have the RFC and the design links.

tim_ong: Noted. I'll avoid sweeping kernel-level tuning until we validate SNI/fallback behavior.

alex_k: Thanks all — will update tracker and ping folks with calendar invites. :thumbsup:
